Name: Mouse Move Mode (multilingual)
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[size=4][b][i]The English description is below[/i][/b][/size]


[b][i][size=5][color=#444444].[/color][/size][/i][/b]
[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6][font=serif]模组功能[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b][i]右键点击或长按右键会让玩家移动，长按移动则在松开后停止[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]骑行时按住Shift键只会右键移动[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]右键点击离玩家太远时，当你靠近时会对指向物体执行动作[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4][b][i]按F6键可开/关右键移动模式（游戏开始时自动开启，配置中可更改）[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]Alt + Enter 可在全屏和窗口模式之间切换[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][b][i][size=4]CRTL + 轮子会放大缩放[/size][/i][/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]原作者不更新，我来更新！[/i][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][b][i][color=#ff7700][size=5]1.4.8更新[/size][/color][/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]新增[color=#ff0000]左键点击模式[/color]，增加[color=#ff0000]鼠标移动模式的切换开关[/color]，支持自定义按键绑定，默认按键为F6[/size][/b][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#cccccc]点击鼠标模式移动开关按键（默认[/color][color=#ff7700]F6[/color][color=#cccccc]），在三个状态间循环：[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#cccccc]左键移动 → 右键移动 → 关闭 → 左键移动 → ...（切换时会立刻中断当前移动）。[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4][color=#cccccc]按下 [/color][color=#ff7700]F6[/color][color=#cccccc] 循环切换时，屏幕左下角会弹出对应的模式[/color][/size][/b]
[img width=169]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54836/54836-1793713152-931570988.png[/img][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][i]1.4.9 更新[/i][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#cccccc]修复了左键移动不能点击物品栏和日志的Bug，[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][b][size=4][i][color=#cccccc]新增[/color][color=#ff0000]强制使用工具键[/color][color=#cccccc]（默认[/color][color=#ff7700]V键[/color][color=#cccccc]），可在模组配置菜单里面更改[/color][/i][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][i][color=#ff7700][size=5]1.4.10更新[/size][/color][/i][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]添加了[color=#ff0000]韩语(한국어)[/color][color=#ffffff]和[/color][color=#ff0000]日语(日本語)[/color][color=#ffffff] 和[/color][color=#ff0000]英文补丁[/color][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][i]1.4.11更新[/i][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ffffff]新增[/color][color=#b45f06]「移动后与目标交互」[/color][color=#ffffff]开关[/color][color=#b45f06]（默认开启）[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ffffff]开启：到达即交互（左右键模式都生效）[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ffffff]关闭：只走到目标停下，不执行任何交互[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]注意[/color][color=#ffffff]：开启后点击NPC，容易将手上的物品赠送给NPC，[/color][color=#ff0000]请谨慎使用！[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][color=#cccccc][size=4][b][i]之后更新会转移到[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54931]MouseMoveMode(Ultimate revision)[/url][/i][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#cccccc][size=4][b]本版本只作为翻译，Bug修复与维护[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4][b]原模组:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2614]Mouse Move Mode[/url][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][color=#666666][b][size=5][i].[/i][/size][/b][/color]
[color=#666666][b][size=5][i].[/i][/size][/b][/color]
[color=#666666][b][size=5][i].[/i][/size][/b][/color]
[color=#666666][b][size=5][i].[/i][/size][/b][/color]
[b][color=#666666][size=5][i].[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=5][i]Module Functions[/i][/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b][i]Right-clicking or holding the right mouse button moves the player; holding to move will stop upon release[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]When riding, holding the Shift key allows movement only via right-click[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]If you right-click a target too far from the player, the action on the pointed object will trigger once you get close[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]Press F6 to toggle the right-click movement mode (automatically enabled when the game starts, configurable in settings)[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][i]Alt + Enter switches between fullscreen and windowed mode[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*][b][i][size=4]Ctrl + Mouse Wheel adjusts zoom magnification[/size][/i][/b][/*]
[/list][color=#ff0000][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b][i]The original author isn't updating it, so I'll take over updates![/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][i]Update 1.4.8[/i][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Added [color=#ff0000]left-click mode[/color], [color=#ff0000]added a toggle for mouse movement[/color] mode with customizable key binding. The default key is [color=#ff7700]F6[/color] and can be changed in the mod menu.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Press the mouse movement mode toggle key (default [color=#ff7700]F6[/color]) to cycle through three states:[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Left-click movement → Right-click movement → Off → Left-click movement → ... (The ongoing movement will stop immediately when switching).[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]When cycling modes by pressing F6, the corresponding mode prompt will pop up at the bottom-left of the screen.[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]  [img width=232]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54836/54836-1793713230-1523589522.png[/img][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][i]Update 1.4.9[/i][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Fixed the bug where left-click movement could not click the inventory and journal.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Added a [color=#ff0000]force-use tool key[/color] (default[color=#ff7700] V key[/color]), It can be changed in the mod configuration menu.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][i]Update 1.4.10[/i][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Added Korean(한국어)[/color] and [color=#ff0000]Japanese(日本語) [/color]and [color=#ff0000]English patch[/color].[/size][/b][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700][size=5][i]Update 1.4.11[/i][/size][/color][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Added the toggle[color=#b45f06] [Interact with Target After Moving][/color][color=#783f04](enabled by default)[/color][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Enabled: Interact upon arrival (works for both left-click and right-click modes)[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Disabled: Only move to the target and stop, no interaction will be performed[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Note: [/color]When enabled, clicking on an NPC may easily give the item in hand to the NPC. [/size][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Please use it with caution![/size][/color][/b][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]Future updates will be moved to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54931]MouseMoveMode(Ultimate revision)[/url].[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]This version will only be for translation, bug fixes and maintenance.[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]Original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2614]Mouse Move Mode[/url][/size][/b][/*]
[/list]
